tasks.short: Educate the public about foot care

steps.what: Select public foot-care messages and authoritative source material
Prepare public education materials for speaking engagements and other forums

loop.purpose: Adapt selected public health explanations to the chosen audience and format
loop.input: Education brief, source passages and permitted general messages
loop.output: Draft slides or public copy with passage references and marked uncertainties
loop.check: Podiatrist checks clinical accuracy, readability, limitations, misleading benefit claims and absence of personalised advice
loop.stop: One revision maximum; unsupported statements are removed or written manually from sources
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates organise material but cannot reliably adapt explanations for different public audiences

steps.what: Check and deliver public foot-care education and address audience questions

tasks.design: Reuse vetted explanations and native templates in {DOCS} first. A bounded draft step adapts only selected source passages; the podiatrist checks the exact final materials before presenting or releasing them and handles audience questions personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Adapting clear public explanations takes preparation even when the underlying messages repeat.
tasks.enabler_now: Constrained drafting can suggest accessible wording from vetted material.
tasks.still_hard: Avoiding overstated benefits and distinguishing general education from individual clinical advice.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise confusion, explain limitations and respond responsibly to personal questions.
tasks.altitude: A small amount of composition time returns to audience engagement.

reach.task: Explain access to reliable health information
reach.learn: Accessible communication and limits of general guidance

evidence.claim: Thuisarts provides guideline-based vetted public health information; suitable foot-care passages must still be selected for the intended audience.
The proposed audience-adaptation saving is an unmeasured design scenario.

assumptions: Boundary includes the podiatrist's preparation and delivery of general public education. Patient consultations and advertising administration by other staff are excluded; no clinical treatment saving is claimed.

Podiatrist produces audience, purpose, format, duration, selected source identifiers and versions, permitted claims and excluded personalised topics in s1's 20 hours. Missing or unsuitable sources trigger manual preparation from approved material within retained s2 time.
Native templates and reuse of existing approved material are tested before a model extension. Existing software runtime earns no labour saving.
No patient records enter the drafting workflow. Public release remains a practitioner action; paid advertisement placement is outside this boundary.
unknowns: Frequency and format of public education
Availability of suitable approved source passages
Local review requirements for promotional claims
research_questions: Does audience adaptation save more time than source checking, correction and ongoing material maintenance?

already_counted.description: Review and revise drafted explanations against source meaning

incremental.description: Refresh vetted sources and check recurring drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact final slides or public copy with source versions and benefit claims; any content change voids approval before delivery or release

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+17.5+55=92.5, gross=7.5, upkeep=4, net=3.5. Range 0-2 allows infrequent events, clinical wording corrections and delivery-heavy work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Public education keeps practitioner judgement and delivery while selected prose adaptation receives modest assistance.
reach: Explain reliable health information access to varied audiences
role.ambitious_version: A podiatrist who uses carefully checked draft support and gives the public clear, proportionate explanations.
